info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Credit Risk Model Update API
info.description: The Credit Risk Model Update API allows financial institutions to modify existing credit risk models to reflect changes in risk assessment criteria or business strategies. This API provides functionalities to update parameters and configurations of credit risk models, ensuring that institutions have the most relevant and accurate risk evaluation tools. Typical consumers include risk management teams and financial analysts seeking to adapt models to evolving market conditions. With this API, organizations can maintain compliance and optimize their lending processes.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific credit risk model identified by RES-100045. Ensure that the necessary fields are included in your request to make the desired updates.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the parameters of the credit risk model identified by RES-100045. It allows the client to modify various attributes of the existing model, facilitating adjustments based on new data or insights.
